neighbours.label: The '-in' piece of '-informed' compounds (well-informed, trauma-informed); other hyphen compounds stay quiet
fire: Voters here tend to be unusually well-informed about the budget.
This clinic follows a culturally-informed approach to therapy.
Our firm takes a data-informed view of hiring.
The agency adopted a science-informed policy on fishing.
She is a remarkably well-informed reader of history.
Teachers now receive trauma-informed training every summer.
We need a more climate-informed plan for the coast.
Doctors want evidence-informed guidelines for the clinic.
quiet: Voters here tend to be unusually well-behaved about the budget.
This clinic follows a family-centred approach to therapy.
Our firm takes a long-term view of hiring.
The agency adopted a science-based policy on fishing.
She is a remarkably well-read student of history.
Teachers now receive first-aid training every summer.
We need a more climate-friendly plan for the coast.
Doctors want evidence-based guidelines for the clinic.

notes: The card also shows invention words in Arabic, Russian and Japanese at the top, but probes of them read under 0.05, so they are left out. Max is 984, so readings of 0.13-0.43 are large in absolute terms.
